issues.reason: Thematic roles: a transitive subject is Agent even when inanimate and non-volitional ('the storm broke the mast'), the undergoer test being for intransitives, and only possession (Holder) or stative psych/perception (Experiencer) demote it — eventive 'lose' is neither.

Measures & units folds a measured-amount object into a Measure with no role atom ('The box weighs 5 kilograms', 'costs $20' -> scale price), so '11/32 in price' taking no Theme/Patient is licensed; the atom is removed below for its magnitude and unit, not for missing a role.

Fraction is defined only as the polymorphic level slot of ProportionOf in Partitives, while a Measure magnitude is 'a native number' (or a ParticleFromNormal distribution), so (Fraction 11 32) is ill-typed there and invisible to Compute/GreaterThan.
'point' occurs nowhere in the sentence, and Core patterns' test — point at the words that put the atom there — fails: world knowledge picks the reading, it never adds content.

Compound concepts states that a noun modifier is never exposed as its own atom (fire_exit is not fire, delivery_van is not delivery); a classifying noun modifier belongs inside a fused symbol whose genus is emitted, so (Member us10yt_rr benchmark) is unlicensed.
'late on Monday' sits inside the from-phrase and dates the prior yield level, so (Time sk_lose_1 (Weekday monday)) puts the loss on a day the text never assigns it.
Time licenses bare Time symbols only for speech-anchored deictics and the day-parts morning/afternoon/evening/night; 'late' is a degree modifier on a time, not a time, so the atom is ill-typed.

Measures & units takes the scale from a stated dimension (a gradable adjective or a dimension noun) and duration is the extent of an eventuality; '10-year note' states no dimension and a note is not an eventuality, so both the scale and its application are supplied from world knowledge.

Both yield atoms are true and well-typed — the scale 'yield' and unit 'percent' are stated and the prior level is correctly tense-wrapped — and the reviewer's own gaps record that no licensed form encodes a value's movement between levels or a free participial adjunct, which the calibration line makes acceptable improvisation rather than a defect.

gaps_confirmed: numeric attributive compounds ('10-year note') — the compound rules cover adjective and noun modifiers, not a number+unit modifier, and no scale is stated to hang a Measure on
a free participial adjunct on a clause ('…, taking its yield to X from Y') — only participial post-modifiers on a NOUN (reduced relatives) are covered
change in a measured value ('to 3.21 percent from 3.17 percent') — no form encodes one entity's value moving from one level to another
a fractional magnitude ('11/32') — Fraction exists only as a ProportionOf level and magnitudes are native numbers
new_gaps: a stated scale with an unstated unit ('lost 11/32 in price') — Measure's fourth slot has nothing licensed to fill it, so the whole amount becomes unemittable
a delta measured on an EVENT (the size of a loss) — Measure is defined for an entity's level, with duration the only event-side scale
repair_summary: Fused the classifying noun modifier into (Member us10yt_rr benchmark_note) with its genus (Inheritance benchmark_note note), replacing the bare note typing and the exposed (Member us10yt_rr benchmark). Removed (Measure us10yt_rr duration 10 year) — no dimension stated, and duration is an eventuality scale. Changed (Patient sk_lose_1 us10yt_rr) to (Agent sk_lose_1 us10yt_rr) for the transitive subject. Removed (Measure sk_lose_1 price (Fraction 11 32) point) entirely — a Fraction magnitude is ill-typed and 'point' is not in the text, and no licensed encoding remains for it. Removed (Time sk_lose_1 (Weekday monday)) and (Time sk_lose_1 late) — Monday dates the from-value, which has no event witness to carry a Time atom, and 'late' is not a licensed time symbol.
notes: The two yield measures and the Name/symbol for US10YT=RR are left untouched; the repair loses '11/32', '10-year' and 'late on Monday' because each falls in registered gap territory where the only alternative was invention.
